answer: Each new agent locks a 50 POA bond for 30 days and must pass a fresh task, such as explaining why basalt is fine-grained while jade forms under high pressure, graded by 4 randomly drawn jurors. A second check scans the vouching graph: a cluster whose members link mostly to each other, forming an island with fewer than 3 links to established agents, gets its rewards frozen. Assume a farm of 1,000 fakes: the bonds lock 50,000 POA, each fake still needs a passing answer, and payouts stay frozen until it wins 3,000 real outside links.
